description: This file is a shell script that manages preparation and validation tasks for pull requests in a software project. It includes functions for initializing preparation context, validating commits, pushing changes, synchronizing with the main branch, and orchestrating the entire preparation process.

methods.name: checkout_prep_branch
methods.description: Checks out the preparation branch corresponding to a given pull request.

methods.name: resolve_prep_branch_name
methods.description: Resolves the name of the preparation branch for a PR, verifying its existence.

methods.name: verify_prep_branch_matches_prepared_head
methods.description: Verifies that the local prep branch contains the expected commit SHA.

methods.name: prepare_init
methods.description: Initializes the preparation context for a PR, setting up the worktree, fetching PR data, and creating environment files.

methods.name: prepare_validate_commit
methods.description: Validates the latest commit message in the PR to ensure it does not contain PR number or contributor thanks.

methods.name: prepare_push
methods.description: Pushes the prepared branch to the PR branch, verifying the head SHA and updating environment files.

methods.name: prepare_sync_head
methods.description: Synchronizes the prep branch with the main branch, rebasing if necessary, and updates related environments.

methods.name: prepare_run
methods.description: Orchestrates the full preparation process: init, gates, and push steps.
